title: Every bus in Burlington in 24 hours
description:
Every bus running in Burlington on an average November weekday, from the morning rush to the next morning, in 50 seconds.

Burlington Transit has no October timetable, so I used November 2 to 27 for it and October 2026 for the other agencies. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and put each vehicle where its schedule says it is. The count is the average for that minute and only includes vehicles inside the Burlington city limits. The faded ones are just outside. Colours: Frequent, Regular and GO, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment: 65 buses at 5:45 pm.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in the other timetables and leaves out Thanksgiving (October 12).
